sets.name: canonical
sets.description: Wave-1 seed corpus. One representative pair per T1..T8. Roadmap target is >=40 pairs (>=5 per category) — this is the seed; corpus curation continues across waves.

sets.name: stress
sets.description: Adversarial pairs that stress the resolver cascade beyond the canonical seed: nested holes, alternation depth >= 3, mixed cardinality, extreme concavity, near-symmetric ambiguity, tangentially-touching rings, and cross-rule fill-rule changes. The W5 calibration corpus draws from this set.
